extracted.name: Waldorf Cabbage Salad
extracted.description: Thinly sliced savoy cabbage pairs up with crisp apples, walnuts and celery in a classic mayonnaise-based Waldorf dressing.
ingredient_lines: 4 apples, cored and diced with peel
instruction_lines: Use a chef’s knife to slice cabbage into thin pieces 1 to 2 inches long. Do not use the large ribs of the cabbage, as they are too strongly flavored.
In a large bowl, toss together the cabbage, apples, walnuts, celery, mayonnaise, sugar and salt until evenly coated. Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator for up to one day.
